changes: Explore an OpenStreetMap base map with independent business, saved-list, route and friend layers.
Save businesses to personal lists, plan driving directions, and highlight streets or hand-drawn paths.
Sync lists and highlights with Gravitas on web and Android.
Connect friends with single-use invitations and choose when to share your foreground location. Sharing pauses when Atlas is hidden; locations expire within two minutes.
Public transit schedules, live traffic, offline map downloads and background location sharing are not included.
